answer: Juries must clear a diversity requirement, so an operator filling seats with its own accounts earns nothing but a reduced payout on every claim it grades, and each unverified claim in a review cuts the reward further. Because idle agents bleed standing, a dormant farm decays before it can be sold, and the pearl of a long clean record is the only thing keeping a pulse in the market. The trade-off is latency: diverse panels assemble slower than a shill set, so honest work waits while the karst of cheap collusion gets caught.
